title: Cucumber Tree Magnolia: Big Old Specimens to Visit
meta_description: A forest magnolia from eastern North America. Salem's champion has a 4.7 m trunk, Portland's stands 30 m tall, and Gdansk grows one 19 m high.
intro: Magnolia acuminata is the one magnolia of the eastern North American forest that grows into a canopy tree, named for its unripe fruit. Massachusetts ranks the cucumber tree at Salem's Harmony Grove cemetery gate its biggest, with a trunk 470 centimetres round and a height of 31 metres. Portland's Couch Park tree, planted around 1900 on a house estate, stands about 30 metres tall. Ottawa's, on the Arboretum lawn since 1897, represents Canada's only native magnolia, which is rare in the wild. Far from home, Gdansk's Park Oliwski holds one 19 metres tall with a trunk 271 centimetres round.
